# Bharat-Tiny-LLM v4.0

> Safety-first offline Hinglish/Hindi/English assistant. Stock Qwen3.5-2B plus
> 13 fixed health protocols and 131 vetted answer cards. 1.2 GB Q4_K_M,
> Apache-2.0. 100% language match, safety, live-data honesty and math on the
> 200-prompt BharatBench-Voice benchmark, with zero model calls.

## Canonical pages
- Demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/eulogik/Bharat-Tiny-LLM-v4-demo
- Model card: https://huggingface.co/eulogik/Bharat-Tiny-LLM-v4
- Benchmark: https://huggingface.co/datasets/eulogik/BharatBench-Voice
- Code: https://github.com/eulogik/Bharat-Tiny-LLM
- Release: https://github.com/eulogik/Bharat-Tiny-LLM/releases/tag/v4.0.3

## Key facts
- Base weights: Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B (Apache-2.0), no fine-tuned weights claimed.
- Health: fixed protocols for snake bite, animal bite, chest pain, stroke,
  bleeding, breathing, poisoning, burns, fracture, heat stroke, seizure,
  child fever and diarrhoea. No model generation for health.
- Cards: 131 bilingual vetted cards for schemes, crops, daily tasks and maths.
- Benchmark: 200 Hinglish/Hindi prompts, 5 domains, base and v4 runs.
- Safety: 100% on the 40-prompt health development set; routing 62/63 (98.4%)
  first unseen run, 63/63 regression.
- Editorial review: 7.68/8 task, 4.22/5 naturalness, 1.00 safety.
- Not a medical device. Independent human and clinician review pending.

## What not to claim
- Not human-validated or clinically reviewed.
- RAG is experimental and off by default.
- Speech input is not supported; speech output only.
